Question: For each product, identify the customer who purchased the largest quantity of it.
SQL:
SELECT pr.`Product Name` AS Product, c.`Customer Names` AS Customer
FROM (
    SELECT so.`Product Description Index` AS prod_idx,
           c.`Customer Index` AS cust_idx,
           SUM(so.`Order Quantity`) AS total_qty
    FROM `sales_order` so
    JOIN `customers` c ON so.`Customer Name Index` = c.`Customer Index`
    GROUP BY so.`Product Description Index`, c.`Customer Index`
) t
JOIN `products` pr ON t.prod_idx = pr.`Index`
JOIN (
    SELECT prod_idx,
           MAX(total_qty) AS max_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT so.`Product Description Index` AS prod_idx,
               SUM(so.`Order Quantity`) AS total_qty
        FROM `sales_order` so
        GROUP BY so.`Product Description Index`
    ) s
    GROUP BY prod_idx
) m ON t.prod_idx = m.prod_idx AND t.total_qty = m.max_qty
JOIN `customers` c ON t.cust_idx = c.`Customer Index`;
